method: The original BalanceSim and four arm definitions execute unchanged on the exploratory runtime. Original-catalogue optional research fields are absent. Fresh non-protected seeds are used; these are not the signed acceptance cohorts or a main qualification. Research source/default-law equivalence and content identities remain explicit. Both content catalogues are fixed before rows. Mob overrides are empty.
finding: Do not equate the stronger native-planning balanced RandomBuild screen with original arm2. Original control samples are much lower here. This does not establish P9: original planned pilots also perform poorly on the experimental catalogue, and newer mechanics require adequate measurement coverage. The bridge is not a reason to weaken C2 or pretend either controller family is optimal.
limits: Not signed C2/PhaseA/landscape or a protected-seed PASS
Research native-controller samples use a different cohort; cross-study rates are not a paired causal contrast
Original pilots may not understand optional new mechanics
No package, detector, retention or integration admission
